Name: Utility Grid Redux
Author: ThaleTheGreat
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=3]*[/size][/color][size=3]If you [color=#00ff00]like[/color] my [color=#00ffff]mods[/color] consider [color=#ff0000]Endorsing[/color]![color=#ffff00]*[/color][/size]

[b][size=4]Utility Grid Redux[/size][/b] adds two utility systems:

[b][color=#00ffff]Water grids[/color][/b] supply sprinklers, water tanks, pumps, and optional pipe irrigation.

[b][color=#ffff00]Power grids[/color][/b] supply machines, batteries, pumps, and other powered equipment.

You can cycle through the grid overlay to see what is connected to power and water. There is also a [color=#00ff00][size=4]brand new[/size][/color] editor menu built for this Redux that supports drag placement as well.

The original Utility Grid setup was split across several separate mods and add-ons. Utility Grid Redux brings those systems together into one main mod.

It combines and replaces the old setup for:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10197]Utility Grid[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10205]Pipe Irrigation[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10198]Simple Irrigation System[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10199]Simple Electricity System[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10231]Utility Grid Storage[/url]

This version does not need Dynamic Game Assets, Producer Framework Mod, or Content Patcher for the utility equipment.

It also updates the old setup with cleaner grid editing, separate overlay and edit controls, Better Crafting support, rain-filling water tanks, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47246]Tool and Sprinkler Upgrades[/url] sprinkler support.

[size=4][b]Default Controls[/b][/size]
[spoiler]All controls can be changed in the config menu.

Back - Toggle the grid overlay.
Home - Toggle grid editing.
Delete - Switch between water and power grid editing.
Page Up - Change the pipe or line shape.
Page Down - Rotate the pipe or line shape.
Left Click - Place pipe or power line.
Right Click - Remove pipe or power line.[/spoiler]
[size=4][b]Pipe Irrigation[/b][/size]

Pipe irrigation is optional.

When enabled, water pipes can water nearby tilled soil. By default, pipe irrigation costs [b]1 water for every 4 tiles watered[/b].

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Water Equipment[/b][/size][/color]
[spoiler][b]Water pumps add water to your grid:[/b]

[b]Bronze Water Pump[/b] produces 10 water and uses 2 power. It must be placed in water.
[b]Steel Water Pump[/b] produces 25 water and uses 4 power. It must be placed in water.
[b]Gold Water Pump[/b] produces 80 water and uses 8 power.
[b]Iridium Water Pump[/b] produces 200 water and uses 16 power.

[b]Water storage:[/b]

[b]Water Tank[/b] stores 50 water and outputs 2 water. [color=#00ff00]The Redux also lets it fill from rain.[/color]

[b]Sprinklers use water from the grid:[/b]

[b]Sprinkler[/b] uses 1 water.
[b]Quality Sprinkler[/b] uses 2 water.
[b]Iridium Sprinkler[/b] uses 6 water and 2 power.

If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47246]Tool and Sprinkler Upgrades[/url] is installed, these sprinklers are also supported:

[b][color=#0000ff]Cobalt Sprinkler[/color][/b] uses 10 water and 3 power.
[b][color=#ff0000]Pris[/color][color=#ff7700]ma[/color][color=#00ff00]tic[/color] [color=#00ffff]Sprin[/color][color=#9900ff]kler[/color][/b] uses 25 water and 6 power.
[b][color=#00ff00]Radioactive Sprinkler[/color][/b] uses 50 water and 10 power.[/spoiler]
[color=#ffff00][size=4][b]Power Equipment[/b][/size][/color]
[spoiler][b]Some machines add power to the grid:[/b]


[b]Furnace[/b] produces 10 power while processing.
[b]Charcoal Kiln[/b] produces 10 power while processing.
[b]Solar Panel[/b] produces 10 power when it has sun.


[b]Batteries store power:[/b]


[b]Utility Grid Battery[/b] stores 50 power and outputs 2 power.
[b]Utility Grid Advanced Battery[/b] stores 100 power and outputs 5 power.

[color=#00ff00][size=3][u]All equipment is fully configurable.[/u][/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

Utility Grid Redux includes support for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47246]Tool and Sprinkler Upgrades[/url] sprinklers.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47690]Industrialization for Utility Grid Redux[/url] was made explicitly for this mod.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115]Better Crafting[/url] is also supported. When installed, the utility equipment appears in its own [b]Utilities[/b] category.

[b]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]
